column1: # Offsets are intentionally left blank: ESP-IDF computes them
# partitions to 64 KB. Do not hardcode offsets unless there is a reason.
# Sizes reserve space for the gateway Wi-Fi/router application and an unused
# legacy asset partition. The total fits a 4 MB flash (see sdkconfig.defaults).
# TODO(station-board): decide whether OTA slots are needed.
# "www" is retained from the former onboard-hosting design
# The UI/API runs on a separate server (the fixed-IP PC in the demo).
# The legacy web/scripts/mklittlefs.sh reads this size only for historical use.
